Open-source licenses and attribution

This application uses original interface code, text and SVG icons created for this project, alongside the following third-party libraries. It does not use iLovePDF’s logo, source code or website copy.

  • pdf-lib 1.17.1 — MIT license
  • PDF.js 5.6.205 — Apache License 2.0
  • Foxit standard-font notices
  • Liberation fonts — SIL Open Font License

Additional notices are retained with bundled CMaps and WASM components. Users should process only files they have the right to use. Processing does not grant rights to another person’s content.

Branding

yourPDF is a provisional name. This project is independent of other similarly named services and does not claim affiliation with them. A final name and domain require a separate branding review before commercial promotion.
